run.question: Fetch me the logs for the inventory-service pod in namespace app-102

report.summary: The requested pod exists: inventory-service-7ff7d5959f-b57kz in namespace app-102 was Running with 0 container restarts, created 2026-11-21T05:05:11Z. Its application container emits nothing on stdout/stderr — a fetch of the pod's container logs returned 8 lines, all from the promtail log-shipper sidecar, and 0 bytes/lines from the inventory-service container itself. The service's application log is a file, /var/log/inventory.log, shipped by the promtail sidecar to Loki; a Loki query for namespace app-102 returned 8 application log lines from this pod spanning 2026-11-21T05:05:13.803Z to 2026-11-21T05:05:46.329Z, 7 at INFO and 1 at WARN ("Low stock warning for ITEM-9999 - current level: 5 units"); no ERROR-level line was returned in that sample. The short history is explained by the pod's age: events show Deployment inventory-service scaling replica set inventory-service-7ff7d5959f from 0 to 1 at 2026-11-21T05:05:11Z, i.e. roughly 35 seconds before the window end, not a restart of an existing pod. Log retrieval over the full authorized window failed with TOOL_TIMEOUT, and a Loki query restricted to 2026-11-21T01:00:00Z–2026-11-21T05:05:00Z returned no_data, so coverage before 05:05:13Z is unknown rather than empty.
